propositions: The two-clone enrichment regression test for bug 8185 requires git merge-tree --write-tree, which is only available in Git 2.38+, but the repository does not declare or enforce a minimum Git version.
Without explicit version floor enforcement, contributors and CI on older Git clients can run tests that silently skip or degrade, making the regression test vacuous and reducing coverage visibility.

The solution enforces Git >= 2.38 at session startup via pytest_configure calling floor_violation(), aborting the entire test session with a diagnostic before any test runs, rather than using skip guards that could go unnoticed.

The Git version floor is single-sourced in .github/git-version-floor.txt and consistently enforced across contributor documentation (README, CONTRIBUTING, local-dev-env.md), CI workflows (_build-and-test.yml), and test infrastructure (tests/_git_floor.py).

Regression guards in the test suite ensure the merge-tree capability is still actively tested and no skip machinery guards it, preventing the regression from becoming dormant via module splits or refactoring.
